headline: Set 2027 meeting dates and discuss other business.
summary: The main business is setting the 2027 meeting dates. The meeting will also discuss other business.
location: First Floor Meeting Room 1-2 (#114), City Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT
plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Board of Assessment Appeals 
 
In person only meeting  
 
 
 
 
 
The regular Board of Assessment Appeals meeting will be held on November 5, 2026 at 4:30 
p.m. in the First Floor Meeting Room 1-2 (#114) in City Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT. 
 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. Approval of the minutes from the September 2026 BAA Hearings  
3. Set 2027 meeting dates  
4. Discuss any other Board business  
5. Adjourn  
  
Per Order of the Chairperson, Ann Marie Heering
